caption: The flap of a lit tent is unzipped from inside at night, and lantern light spills out onto the grass in a triangle that widens as the flap opens.

sa.check: Lantern light spills out onto the grass.
The lit patch widens as the flap opens.
It is night and the tent is lit from inside.
The lit patch is a triangle.

pc.expect: The lit patch appears only once the flap parts and lies in front of the doorway, fading with distance.
pc.fail: Light is on the grass with the flap shut; or the patch is beside the tent; or it is even to its far edge.

pc.expect: The patch grows with the opening.
pc.fail: It shrinks as the flap opens; or is full width before the flap moves; or flickers.

pc.expect: The patch changes only as the flap moves.
pc.fail: It grows with the flap still; or before the zip; or jumps.

pc.expect: The patch is a triangle spreading from the doorway.
pc.fail: It is a round spot; or splits; or is on the tent's roof.
A second tent appears; or the lantern vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The tent and the grass stay the same.
pc.fail: The tent changes colour; or the grass changes; or the flap changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
